public.title: Swap Nodes in Pairs
public.description: values encodes a singly linked list in head-to-tail order. Swap each consecutive pair of logical nodes and return the resulting values. An unpaired final node stays last. There are 0 to 1000 integer values from -10000 to 10000.
hints: Process two positions at a time.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Swap each complete adjacent pair, leaving a final singleton untouched. O(n) time and output space; this adaptation checks values rather than pointer identity.
